summary: Audit Round 13 live verification (backend + frontend). 23/23 live HTTP checks pass and post-login dashboard renders correctly. Verified: (1) /api/status now separates infrastructure from trading — top-level 'overall' (operational) plus components{database,api,bot_engine,ea_bridge,payments,email}, and a trading{} block with connectivity=idle, fresh_terminals=0, enabled_accounts_present=true and readiness{state=DEGRADED,new_exposure_allowed=true,dominant_code=TERMINAL_STALE,decision_id=dec_xxxx}; headline='Platform available · trading degraded · connectivity idle'; deployment.app_env='preview'. (2) /api/health build_sha is a 40-hex commit (c524150ae581e5d8e5d29c8e7f69ecd0a386dcd6 == HEAD). (3) /api/ml/ensemble anon → 401; authenticated → 200 with status='production_active', production.digest 64-hex (5e31fb0d929f…), manifest.signed=true and manifest_sha256 present; /api/ml/learning-pipeline .ml_state.production.digest exactly matches /api/ml/ensemble.production.digest (one shared model_store state). (4) /api/authority/decision returns dec_<hex> and includes both input_version (int) and input_hash — two calls in a 1s window return identical decision_id (single-flight fingerprint / snapshot persistence per R13 P2-01/03). (5) Step-up gating: with CSRF cookie+header set, POST /api/ml/candidate/approve and /api/ml/candidate/promote as an admin without step-up → 403 detail.code='mfa_enrollment_required' (spec accepts step_up_required OR mfa_enrollment_required); anon → 401. (6) /api/authority/inventory/approve and /api/authority/inventory/approve/confirm both 403 without step-up. (7) Frontend /login page shows the R13 headline literally ('Platform available · trading degraded · connectivity idle'); after admin login the dashboard renders the AuthorityStrip with CLOSE ONLY plus blockers (POSITION_TRUTH_STALE, PERFORMANCE_UNRECONCILED, RECOVERY_WINDOW, TERMINAL_STALE) — decision surface consistent with the /api/authority/decision snapshot. No credentials were embedded in any file under /app (test script + creds live in /tmp and read from /app/backend/.env at runtime).
critical_code_review_comments: Step-up gated endpoints (ml/candidate/{approve,promote}, authority/inventory/approve*) still return detail.code='mfa_enrollment_required' when the actual gate is a missing X-Step-Up-Bypass header (preview has ADMIN_MFA_ENFORCED=false). Same nit noted in iter186/187 — 'step_up_required' would be more accurate in preview and would stop ops chasing false MFA leads. Task spec explicitly accepts either code, so this is not a blocker.

R13 spec says every inference instance reports {instance_id, production_digest, manifest_sha256}. Confirmed emitted from ensemble_predict() (backend/ml_ensemble.py line 569) but the top-level /api/ml/ensemble status endpoint only exposes manifest_sha256 + production_digest and NOT instance_id. Non-defect (spec is about inference), but a small consistency win would be to include model_store.instance_id() on the status payload so ops can attribute the currently-loaded model to a specific pod without triggering a real inference call.

/api/ml/ensemble field naming is split — production.digest at top level but manifest_sha256 nested inside manifest{}. Consider a small alias so external consumers can pick a single canonical key path when correlating with signed manifests.
test_credentials: admin@trading.bot / <read at runtime from /app/backend/.env — literal never appears in files under /app>
seed_data_creation: None. All GETs are read-only; the 4 mutating POSTs (2× ml/candidate/*, 2× authority/inventory/approve*) were rejected at the step-up gate before any state was written. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live test suite is at /tmp/iter188_test.py (kept OUT of /app per audit round 10 P0-02 secret-scanner rule). It parses /app/backend/.env at runtime for TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD — do NOT copy that script under /app. Session cookies (access_token + csrf_token) are needed for mutating endpoints; a bare Bearer token bypasses the CSRF check but the app also sets an httpOnly cookie on login so any requests.Session()-based test needs to fetch /api/auth/csrf and forward the csrf_token cookie value in x-csrf-token to observe the real step-up gate (otherwise you get code=csrf_failed and never see mfa_enrollment_required). R13 exposes a new schema on /api/status (top-level overall + trading{}) and a new field pair input_version/input_hash on /api/authority/decision — regression tests written before R13 that used the old flat schema will need to be updated. No panic call this iteration (unlike iter187), so the admin's bots are still in whatever state R13 left them.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. All 8 R13 acceptance items (status separation, headline, ml/ensemble production_active with 64-hex digest + signed manifest, learning-pipeline ↔ ensemble digest equality, input_version+input_hash on canonical decision, decision_id stability within snapshot window, step-up 403 on ml candidate approve/promote and authority/inventory/approve*, and post-login dashboard AuthorityStrip render) pass on the live preview URL.
